Questions before you join

Are these real reviews?

Yes. Every review comes from a player and is read by a moderator before it goes live. Critical reviews stay up; we only remove spam, abuse and personal details.

Do you remove bad reviews?

No. We only remove spam, abuse, personal details and advertising. Negative reviews stay up.

Where do Vantro's replies come from?

Vantro writes them. We publish them under the review, labelled as a reply from Vantro.

Are you connected to Vantro?

We earn a commission when you join through our links. It doesn't change which reviews we publish.
